snippet.title: Payung Raksasa Nabawi Saling Menumpuk, Tapi Tidak Bertabrakan!! #informatif #faktaunik
snippet.description:
Di halaman Masjid Nabawi, Madinah, ada 250 payung lipat raksasa yang bisa menaungi ratusan jemaah per payung. Kain payung yang bersebelahan sengaja dibuat menumpuk supaya atapnya menyambung tanpa celah. Kalau semua payung sama tinggi, tepi kainnya akan bertabrakan saat dibuka. Karena itu payung dibuat dalam dua ukuran tinggi saat terbuka, 15,3 meter dan 14,4 meter, selisihnya hampir satu meter, sehingga tepi kain payung yang lebih tinggi lewat di atas tepi kain payung di sebelahnya.

Catatan gambar: bentuk rangka, jarak antartiang, dan jemaah di video adalah ilustrasi yang disederhanakan, bukan salinan gambar teknik aslinya. Bagian "kalau sama tinggi" adalah pengandaian.

Sumber: SL Rasch (perancang payung), Madinah Piazza Shading Project: "two different heights. This allows their membranes to be overlapped to create a continuous canopy", tinggi 14,4 m atau 15,3 m saat terbuka; Arab News (250 electric umbrellas, 22 Juni 2022); Architect Magazine (Medina Haram Piazza); Al-Madina (16 Mei 2026).

19-year-old Ayyoub Bouaddi leveled for City in the 67th minute with his first senior goal off a Jérémy Doku assist.

Noa Lang restored Napoli's lead in the 76th minute with a far-post volley, before Rayan Cherki clinched a 2-2 final result in the 86th minute from an Iliman Ndiaye pass

snippet.description:

snippet.title: Großfahndung bei Münchberg: Polizei sucht flüchtigen Audi-Fahrer mit Hubschrauber und Suchhunden
snippet.description:
UPDATE (Dienstag, 24. November / 14:26 Uhr)

Wie die Polizei informiert, konnten Einsatzkräfte um 13:50 Uhr den gesuchten Mann in einem Waldstück westlich von Münchberg aufspüren und festnehmen. Die umfangreichen Fahndungsmaßnahmen sind damit beendet.

Weitere Informationen zur Person des Festgenommenen sowie zu den Umständen seiner Flucht liegen derzeit noch nicht vor. Sobald neue Erkenntnisse vorliegen, wird die Polizei weiter informieren.
_______________________________________
Seit den Morgenstunden sucht die Polizei im Raum Münchberg (Landkreis Hof) mit einem Großaufgebot nach einem etwa 50-jährigen Mann. Dieser hatte sich gegen 9:15 Uhr auf der A9 einer Polizeikontrolle entzogen und war nach dem Abstellen seines Audi A6 in einem Waldstück zu Fuß geflüchtet.

Bei der Durchsuchung des Fahrzeugs fanden die Beamten Betäubungsmittel und Rauschgiftutensilien. Die Suche nach dem Mann läuft unter anderem mit Suchhunden und einem Polizeihubschrauber. Er trug zuletzt eine blaue Jacke und eine schwarze Hose. Außerdem hatte er mutmaßlich eine blaue Reisetasche dabei.

Die Polizei warnt davor, in dem betroffenen Gebiet Anhalter mitzunehmen. Wer verdächtige Beobachtungen macht, soll diese umgehend über den Notruf 110 melden.

snippet.title: I Turned 5 Potatoes Into a Whole Platter of Crispy Pockets!
snippet.description:
Got 5 Potatoes? Make These Golden Piroshki!

Mash 5 boiled potatoes. Add 200 ml warm milk, 1 tsp each of salt, sugar and seasoning, ⅓ tsp black pepper and 7 g dry yeast. Knead in 400–450 g flour. Cover and let rise until doubled.

Chop 7 boiled eggs. Mix with fresh herbs, salt, spices and 50 ml hot oil.

Shape the dough into 16–18 balls. Cover for 10 min. Flatten, add filling and pinch into triangles. Cover for 20 min, then fry in oil over medium heat until golden on both sides.

snippet.description:
Experience the warmth and nostalgia of a beautiful 1990s village story, brought to life in handmade watercolor-painted 2D animation. 🌾🎨

In a peaceful little Indian village, One beautiful morning, Grandma discovers that the village mela is reopening. Excited by the news, she dreams of preparing her favourite traditional food and serving it to the entire village. Grandpa happily supports her dream, and together they transform their old wooden handcart into a charming little food stall. 🏡❤️

Their special mela menu is Amritsari Aloo Kulcha & Chole !

Grandma carefully prepares traditional Amritsari Chole with whole Kabuli chickpeas and aromatic spices. She also prepares delicious potato stuffing and makes fresh, soft Aloo Kulcha’s on a hot iron tava, brushing them generously with homemade white butter.

As the evening arrives, their little stall opens at the colourful village food mela.
Grandma lovingly cooks fresh Amritsari Aloo Kulcha’s while Grandpa serves delicious bowls of Amritsari Chole. Soon, a huge crowd gathers around their stall. Families fill the wooden benches, customers stand in long queues, and everyone enjoys the delicious food with pickled onions, green chillies and lemon wedges.

After a long and busy evening, their little stall becomes a wonderful success. Tired but delighted, Grandma and Grandpa count their day’s earnings and share a proud, happy smile. A beautiful reward for their hard work and togetherness. ❤️

A heartwarming story about love, teamwork, traditional cooking, village life and the simple happiness of fulfilling a dream.

"웃음이 터져서 두 손으로 얼굴을 가렸는데, 입에서 나오는 고음은 단 1초도 흔들리지 않는다!"

이번 영상은 올라운더 보컬 엔믹스(NMIXX) 해원이 라이브 방송 중 아델(Adele)의 대표 명곡 'Rolling in the Deep'을 즉석에서 열창한 커버 라이브 영상입니다!

"We could have had it all Rolling in the deep..." 의자에 편안하게 앉아 가볍게 첫 소절을 시작하는 듯하지만, 후렴구 고음으로 올라가는 순간 매끈하고 단단하게 뻗어 나가는 발성이 단숨에 본업 천재의 위엄을 증명합니다. 옆에서 신나게 리듬을 타는 릴리 덕분에 웃음이 새어 나와 얼굴을 가리는 와중에도, "inside of your hand"에서 묵직하게 힘을 실어 소리를 꽂아 넣는 타격감이 소름을 유발하네요. 유쾌한 분위기 속에서도 결코 숨길 수 없는 해원의 명품 보컬 폼을 감상해 보세요.
